evidence: PDF p.98 (printed 96), verse 635b: «وَالْآخِرَةُ المَرْفُوعُ بِالخَفْضِ وُكِّلَا» (with madda آ on the second alif and sukun on lam); cf. quran-uthmani.txt 6:32 «ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ».
reasoning: The app text writes «وَٱلَاخِرَةُ» with a plain fatha on the alif (اَ), losing both the madda (آ) printed in the PDF and the hamza (ـٔ) of Uthmani 6:32 «ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ» (if Uthmani style is desired, «وَٱلۡـَٔاخِرَةُ» or «وَٱلۡآخِرَةُ»). Without the madda or hamza, the word reads as a short vowel instead of long «ā» in «al-ākhiratu».
